title: The Locked Library
intro: You wake up on a cold wooden floor. Dust hangs in the lamplight. Tall shelves, a heavy oak desk, an old portrait, a silent grandfather clock - and a steel door with a glowing keypad. The door is locked. Somewhere in this library is the way out.
instructions: Type what you want to do in plain English, e.g. "examine the desk", "take the key" or "enter 1234 on the drawer".
Look closely at everything - clues build on each other.
Pick up items you find; you can only use items in your inventory.
Use the Restart button in the sidebar to start over.

desk.description: a heavy oak desk covered in papers
desk.examine: Among the papers lies a handwritten note.

bookshelf.description: a tall bookshelf full of dusty leather books
bookshelf.examine: Four books have coloured spines, each with a single handwritten number: green 5, red 2, yellow 9, blue 6.

drawer.description: a drawer in the desk with a 4-digit combination lock
drawer.examine_locked: The drawer is shut tight by a 4-digit combination lock.
drawer.unlock_text: The lock clicks and the drawer slides open. Inside are a small brass key and a magnifying glass.

painting.description: a portrait of a stern old librarian in a gilded frame
painting.examine: Near the bottom corner there is some writing, far too small to read with the naked eye.

examine_with.text: Through the magnifying glass the tiny writing reads: 'Time remembers the code.'

clock.description: a tall grandfather clock with a locked glass case
clock.examine_locked: The clock is not ticking. Its glass case is locked and has a small brass keyhole.
clock.unlock_text: The brass key turns and the case swings open. The clock hands are frozen at exactly 4:18.
clock.examine: The case is open. The clock hands are frozen at exactly 4:18.

door.description: a steel door with a glowing 4-digit keypad - the only exit
door.examine_locked: A heavy steel door. The keypad beside it waits for a 4-digit code.
door.unlock_text: The keypad flashes green, the bolts slide back and the door swings open. Fresh air rushes in - you are free!

note.description: The note reads: 'Read the spines in the order of the rainbow.'

brass key.description: A small brass key, the kind that fits a delicate lock.

magnifying glass.description: A magnifying glass with a worn wooden handle.

hints.text: The desk looks like someone left in a hurry. Maybe start there.
The note talks about spines. Which piece of furniture has spines?
Rainbow order: red, orange, yellow, green, blue... Read the book numbers in that order.
The open drawer holds things worth taking with you.
The open drawer holds things worth taking with you.
The portrait has writing too small to read. Something in your inventory could help.
That small brass keyhole on the clock looks familiar.
The clock stopped at a very specific time. The keypad wants four digits.
